cut_routing.criterion: Does shot intent require character performance?
cut_routing.no: LIMITED is legal if Layout, sound, and declared hold/pan are real
cut_routing.yes: loop/zoom cannot impersonate performance; I2V_STANDARD or I2V_HARD
cut_routing.A1: LIMITED HUD + cue in first second
cut_routing.A2: LIMITED 1.5-2s hold with sound and correct framing
cut_routing.A3: LIMITED or H3 micro-reaction; VO is TTS API
cut_routing.A4: Layout first, not H3. Character small, perspective and light integrated.
